## 3. Data Models

### 3.1 Backend Models (C#)

```csharp
public enum BadgeLevel
{
    Greenhorn = 1,
    Wayfinder = 2,
    TrailGuide = 3,
    Pioneer = 4
}

public enum CriterionStatus
{
    NotStarted,
    InProgress,
    EvidenceSubmitted,
    Approved,
    Rejected
}

public class Participant
{
    public string UserId { get; set; }           // Azure AD Object ID
    public string DisplayName { get; set; }
    public string Email { get; set; }
    public string Team { get; set; }
    public string GuildName { get; set; }
    public BadgeLevel CurrentLevel { get; set; }
    public bool IsAdmin { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastAdvancementAt { get; set; }
}

public class ExitCriterion
{
    public string Id { get; set; }               // e.g., "greenhorn-1"
    public BadgeLevel Level { get; set; }
    public int CriterionNumber { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public string EvidenceType { get; set; }      // "url", "text", "multi-url"
}

public class EvidenceSubmission
{
    public string Id { get; set; }                // Composite: userId + criterionId
    public string UserId { get; set; }
    public string CriterionId { get; set; }
    public BadgeLevel Level { get; set; }
    public List<string> EvidenceLinks { get; set; }
    public string Notes { get; set; }
    public CriterionStatus Status { get; set; }
    public string AdminFeedback { get; set; }
    public DateTime? SubmittedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ReviewedAt { get; set; }
    public string ReviewedBy { get; set; }
}

public class LevelSubmission
{
    public string Id { get; set; }                // Composite: userId + level
    public string UserId { get; set; }
    public BadgeLevel Level { get; set; }
    public bool IsSubmitted { get; set; }
    public DateTime? SubmittedAt { get; set; }
    public bool IsApproved { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ApprovedAt { get; set; }
    public string ApprovedBy { get; set; }
}

public class TrainingLink
{
    public string Id { get; set; }
    public BadgeLevel Level { get; set; }
    public string Category { get; set; }          // e.g., "Environment Setup"
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public string Url { get; set; }
    public int SortOrder { get; set; }
}
```

## 4. Azure Table Storage Schema

Azure Table Storage uses PartitionKey + RowKey as composite primary keys.

| Table | PartitionKey | RowKey | Entity |
|-------|-------------|--------|--------|
| `Participants` | `"participant"` | `{userId}` | Participant |
| `EvidenceSubmissions` | `{userId}` | `{criterionId}` | EvidenceSubmission |
| `LevelSubmissions` | `{userId}` | `{level}` | LevelSubmission |
| `TrainingLinks` | `{level}` | `{id}` | TrainingLink |

### Storage Fallback Strategy

```csharp
// In Program.cs — register storage based on config
if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(configuration["AzureTableStorage:ConnectionString"]))
{
    builder.Services.AddSingleton<ITrailStorage, AzureTableStorage>();
}
else
{
    builder.Services.AddSingleton<ITrailStorage, InMemoryStorage>();
}
```

The `InMemoryStorage` implementation uses `ConcurrentDictionary` collections mirroring each table. This ensures the app runs without Azure infrastructure during local development and testing.

## 5. API Design

### 5.1 Participant Endpoints

| Method | Route | Description | Auth |
|--------|-------|-------------|------|
| `GET` | `/api/participant/me` | Get current user's participant profile | User |
| `GET` | `/api/participant/me/criteria` | Get exit criteria for current level | User |
| `GET` | `/api/participant/me/evidence` | Get all evidence submissions for current level | User |
| `PUT` | `/api/participant/me/evidence/{criterionId}` | Save/update evidence for a criterion | User |
| `POST` | `/api/participant/me/submit` | Submit current level for review | User |
| `GET` | `/api/participant/me/history` | Get completed level history | User |
| `GET` | `/api/training-links/{level}` | Get training links for a badge level | User |

### 5.2 Admin Endpoints

| Method | Route | Description | Auth |
|--------|-------|-------------|------|
| `GET` | `/api/admin/pending` | List all pending level submissions | Admin |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/participants` | List all participants with optional search/filter | Admin |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/participants/{userId}` | Get full profile and history for a participant | Admin |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/participants/{userId}/evidence` | Get all evidence for a participant's current level | Admin |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/evidence/{submissionId}/approve` | Approve a single criterion | Admin |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/evidence/{submissionId}/reject` | Reject a criterion (requires feedback body) | Admin |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/participants/{userId}/advance` | Approve full level advancement | Admin |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/stats` | Aggregate program stats (counts per level, % Wayfinder) | Admin |

### 5.3 Request/Response Examples

**PUT** `/api/participant/me/evidence/greenhorn-1`
```json
{
  "evidenceLinks": ["https://github.com/org/repo/tree/mmihajlov1/feature"],
  "notes": "Sample app with AI-generated feature branch"
}
```

**POST** `/api/admin/evidence/{submissionId}/reject`
```json
{
  "feedback": "Branch link does not contain your username. Please resubmit with the correct branch."
}
```

**GET** `/api/admin/stats` → Response
```json
{
  "totalParticipants": 150,
  "levelCounts": {
    "Greenhorn": 45,
    "Wayfinder": 80,
    "TrailGuide": 20,
    "Pioneer": 5
  },
  "wayfinderPercentage": 70.0,
  "pendingReviews": 12
}
```

## 6. Authentication & Authorization

### 6.1 Azure AD Integration (Production)

```csharp
// AzureAdAuthExtensions.cs
public static class AzureAdAuthExtensions
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddAzureAdAuth(
        this IServiceCollection services,
        IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
            .AddMicrosoftIdentityWebApi(configuration.GetSection("AzureAd"));

        services.AddAuthorization(options =>
        {
            options.AddPolicy("AdminOnly", policy =>
                policy.RequireClaim("roles", "TrailAdmin"));
        });

        return services;
    }
}
```

### 6.2 Development Bypass

```csharp
// DevBypassAuthHandler.cs
// When environment is Development, inject a mock ClaimsPrincipal
// with a configurable UserId and optional admin role.
// Activated via: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development
```

## 7. Frontend Component Design

### 7.1 Page Components

| Component | Route | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `DashboardPage` | `/` | Developer's personal progress view |
| `AdminDashboardPage` | `/admin` | Admin overview with pending reviews and participant list |
| `ReviewSubmissionPage` | `/admin/review/:userId` | Review a developer's submitted evidence |
| `ParticipantDetailPage` | `/admin/participant/:userId` | View any participant's full history |

### 7.2 Shared Components

| Component | Props | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `BadgeCard` | `level`, `isCurrentLevel` | Displays badge icon, name, and level number |
| `CriteriaChecklist` | `criteria`, `evidence`, `onSave` | List of exit criteria with status indicators |
| `EvidenceInput` | `criterion`, `submission`, `onChange` | URL text input(s) with notes field |
| `ProgressBar` | `completed`, `total` | Visual progress toward level completion |
| `TrainingLinkList` | `links` | Grouped training links by category |
| `SubmissionStatus` | `status`, `feedback` | Status chip with optional rejection feedback |
| `ProtectedRoute` | `requiredRole` | Route wrapper that checks auth and role |

### 7.3 State Management

- **React Query** (`@tanstack/react-query`) for all server state (fetching, caching, mutations)
- No global client state library needed — React Query handles cache invalidation on mutations
- Auth state derived from the API response (`/api/participant/me`)

### 7.4 API Client Setup

```typescript
// api/client.ts
import axios from 'axios';

const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: '/api',
  withCredentials: true, // Send Azure AD session cookie
});

export default apiClient;
```

## 9. Development Workflow

### 9.1 Running Locally

```bash
# Backend
cd src/backend/AiTrailTracker.Api
dotnet run

# Frontend
cd src/frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

### 9.2 Vite Proxy Configuration

```typescript
// vite.config.ts
export default defineConfig({
  server: {
    proxy: {
      '/api': {
        target: 'http://localhost:5000',
        changeOrigin: true,
      },
    },
  },
});
```

### 9.3 Local Auth Bypass

When `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development`, the backend:
1. Skips Azure AD token validation
2. Injects a mock `ClaimsPrincipal` from `appsettings.Development.json`
3. All endpoints work without Azure AD infrastructure

### 9.4 Storage Fallback

When `AzureTableStorage:ConnectionString` is empty or not configured:
1. `InMemoryStorage` is registered instead of `AzureTableStorage`
2. Data persists only for the lifetime of the process
3. Seed data can be loaded on startup for development/demo purposes

## 10. Training Links Seed Data

The following training links should be seeded into the `TrainingLinks` table on startup (or served from config). These are the actual program links:

| Category | Title | URL |
|----------|-------|-----|
| Training Materials | AI SDLC Interactive Training | `https://paycor-ai-sdlc-training-a9azfbfff5ctbnd9.northcentralus-01.azurewebsites.net/` |
| Training Materials | Prior Session Recording | *(Webex recording link)* |
| Training Materials | AI SDLC Documentation | *(SharePoint link)* |
| Environment Setup | Enhanced Context Setup | *(SharePoint link)* |
| Environment Setup | Multi-repo Workspaces | *(SharePoint link)* |
| Environment Setup | AI Attribution and Tagging | *(SharePoint link)* |
| Quality Control | Using AI for Code Reviews — ADO | `https://github.com/PaycorInc/Paycor.PR.Reviewer?tab=readme-ov-file#how-to-add-a-custom-prompt` |
| Quality Control | Using AI for Code Review — GitHub | `https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/use-copilot-agents/request-a-code-review/use-code-review` |

## 11. Testing Strategy

| Layer | Tool | Coverage |
|-------|------|----------|
| Backend Unit Tests | xUnit + Moq | Services, storage logic, auth handler |
| Backend Integration Tests | `WebApplicationFactory` | API endpoints end-to-end with in-memory storage |
| Frontend Unit Tests | Vitest + React Testing Library | Components, hooks |
| Frontend Integration Tests | Vitest + MSW | Page components with mocked API |

Auth bypass is automatically active during test execution (test host uses Development environment).
